text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Chrono Genesis!" "The Grand 
Prix is your stage!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Run like the wind, Kiseki!” “You're the 
protagonist of this race!!”

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"—Run, Bouquet!!" "Make your dream come 
true with your Trainer, Bouquet—!!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (...Ngh, power is surging through me—!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Haa, hah...! Haa—
(Uwooooooah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Both Bouquet and her Trainer are the 
absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep rooting for you! Keep chasing 
victory together――!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "A cheer— ...for us—!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...! It's so warm—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Sunflowers— I'm sure you managed to find 
them.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...What an incredible frenzy, isn't it, 
Bouquet-san?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In this Grand Prix... I intended to leave 
the deepest hoofprints of all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Yet this fervor... The one who left the 
deepest mark on everyone's hearts today... 
............was surely you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Chrono-san—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...We are from the same class, after all. 
I like to think I know at least a little 
about you."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Your strength is unchanging. That is why, 
surely... someday, you will carve out 
entirely new hoofprints."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Driven solely by those pure, innocent 
feelings.

Enveloped in the cheers of her fans— 
Curren Bouquetd'or ignited enormous 
excitement at the Takarazuka Kinen.

The day after seeing how the crowd's 
cheers gave her a tailwind, convinced of 
her potential—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our next race, is it? Let's 
see—"
Bouquet-chan!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Almond... Eye-san...?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: In the autumn 'Japan Cup'! Face me there!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'll definitely beat you, just watch!
